text.tspan: Digital inputs (×6), low-side outputs (×5), CAN, resolver-to-digital converter
Digital input (×6: KEY, BRAKE, P, R, N, D), active high
Low-side output (×5: K_NEG, K_PRE, K_POS, DISCHARGE*, spare)
*DISCHARGE drives the HV-side Q_DIS (sheet 1) through an isolated
photovoltaic MOSFET driver instead of a coil.
split termination: fit only at a bus end
strapped: normal mode, position, 16 bit (verify data sheet)
